definitions.explanation: Rising to a higher position or rank, especially in a professional or official context. Implies a prestigious or honorable advancement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{栄進|えいしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: ご{栄進|えいしん}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められ→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、⟦{局長|きょくちょう}→局長：20023_kyokuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{栄進|えいしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: His long years of achievements were recognized, and he is to be promoted to bureau chief.

notes:
A formal, congratulatory word for promotion. The character {栄|えい} (glory, honor) gives this word a more prestigious and celebratory feel than the neutral ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧. Most commonly seen in congratulatory messages and formal announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{栄進|えいしん}: your promotion (honorific)
- {栄進|えいしん}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧: congratulations on your promotion
- {栄進|えいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate a promotion
- {栄進|えいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{報|しら}せ: news of a promotion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧: promotion — the standard, neutral word for a workplace promotion
- ⟦{昇格|しょうかく}→昇格：08369_shoukaku⟧: promotion in status/grade — focuses on a rise in classification or grade level
- ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧: getting ahead, career success — broader concept of rising in the world, less formal
